faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Straight answers about how SkillSync works for job seekers and for companies.

items.question: How does CV matching work?
items.answer: When you upload a PDF CV, SkillSync reads it and extracts your skills, experience and projects. It compares these with the requirements in each job description and gives you a match score, together with the skills that matched and the ones that are missing.

items.question: Is SkillSync free for job seekers?
items.answer: Yes. Job seekers can create a profile, upload a CV, check their match for jobs, run a skill gap analysis and practise interviews at no cost.

items.question: How is the match score used?
items.answer: The score is a guide, not a verdict. It helps job seekers decide where to apply and helps companies decide whom to read first. Companies still review applications and make every hiring decision themselves.

items.question: How does interview practice work?
items.answer: Choose a role, and the AI interviewer asks questions based on that role. You answer, and SkillSync gives you feedback and a score on your answers, so you know what to improve before the real interview.

items.question: What is a skill gap analysis?
items.answer: It compares the skills on your CV with the skills a job asks for. You see what is missing and get suggested courses to build those skills, so you can apply with more confidence next time.

items.question: How does ranking help companies?
items.answer: Each application is scored against the job description and the list is sorted from strongest to weakest fit. You can open any applicant, see the matched and missing skills, update their status and leave feedback.

items.question: How do companies post a job?
items.answer: Register with the Company role, complete your company profile and open the dashboard. From there you can create vacancies, review applicants, schedule interviews and keep track of every stage.

items.question: Can I use one account as both a job seeker and a company?
items.answer: Each account has one role, so dashboards stay simple. If you need both, register a second account with a different email address.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: Passwords are stored in hashed form, sessions use secure tokens, and your CV is kept as a private file that only you and the companies you apply to can open. Only job-related information is collected.

items.question: Is SkillSync only for jobs in Sri Lanka?
items.answer: SkillSync is built in Sri Lanka and focused on the local market, but every job shows its location, so remote and overseas roles can be listed and found as well.
